title: [BurntSushi/ripgrep] Fix issue #3514: hidden negated ignore patterns
description:
Fix GitHub issue #3514 in BurntSushi/ripgrep: https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3514

Repo: https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep

- An upstream pull request against BurntSushi/ripgrep linked to issue #3514.
- Final submission with commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes.
